rss: Jobless rate falls but small firms cut back hiring
title: Small Shops Hire Fewer Helpers
story: Even though more people have jobs now, small shops are hiring fewer helpers because it costs more. This means some kids might have to wait longer for their turn to work on weekends.
storyBig: Small businesses are feeling the pinch as labor costs increase, leading them to reduce hiring despite a drop in the unemployment rate. This can impact family earnings and weekend job opportunities for kids.
think: Why do you think small shops are hiring fewer people?
bull: Lower jobless rates mean more parents have jobs.
bear: Fewer jobs at local shops could affect families.

rss: Home sellers cut asking prices on 3,000 properties a day
title: House Prices Go Down, Down, Down
story: Lots of people selling houses are lowering their prices to find buyers. This makes it a bit easier for families to move to a new home.
storyBig: Property sellers are cutting asking prices at unprecedented rates, indicating a buyer's market where families could find more affordable options.
think: What happens when house prices get lower?
bull: Families might find their dream home at a good price.
bear: Lower prices could mean some sellers make less money.
